_note: Preview of createKiwiTheme(): MUI 9 createTheme input with cssVariables.colorSchemeSelector = 'data-theme' so MUI and the token CSS switch on one attribute. Density is not a theme instance: styleOverrides read the density-aware custom properties (var(--size-control), var(--space-inset-x), …) which [data-density] re-resolves.

primary._note: MUI contained hover uses primary.dark; text/outlined buttons and links are overridden to --accent-text

secondary._note: neutral: the pink secondary is retired

action._note: hover/selected are opaque tonal steps; focus is the outline ring, never a wash

common._note: read only by InstitutionLogo (G2); the raw-colour guard allows palette.common in that file alone

grey._note: MUI's grey scale overridden with the locked neutral ramp per mode (50 → neutral-1, 100 → 2, 200 → 3, 300 → 5, 400 → 7, 500 → 8, 600 → 10, 700 → 11, 800 → 12, 900 → 12; A100 → 3, A200 → 5, A400 → 8, A700 → 11), so a stray grey.NN or palette.grey[...] still flips with data-theme; a safety net, not a role: migrate by role (page canvas → background.default; sunken band or table head → action.hover; hairline → divider; wordmark fallback → the mascot); the guard flags every grey.NN and palette.grey access

chart._note: series1–5 are --chart-1…5 (categorical, fixed order, marks only: never text, never a status surface); other is --chart-other (Other and Unknown); grid, baseline, tickText and plot are the chart chrome roles (references to semantic tokens); no track is registered (the topic bars have none since the Phase 6 follow-up; the progress bar's track is --in-progress-track). Replaces Phase 3's interim stand-ins; Theme.ts's ChartPalette gains `other` and the chrome keys, and Theme.test.ts expects these values (§ Chart tokens › Hand-offs)
